title: Val x Love's Ryōsuke Asakura Launches New Manga Series
content:
Ryōsuke Asakura launched a new manga series titled Evangeline Puts on Shoes ( Evangeline wa Kutsu o Haku) on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ platform on Wednesday.

The story follows popular high school student and actress Evangeline. While everyone is dazzled by her looks and charm, only the plain Kotarō; an aspiring shoemaker, can see the pain in her footsteps.

Asakura launched the Anastacia no Ikita 9-kakan ( The Last 9 Days of Anastasia ) manga in Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine in February 2024 and ended it on September 12, 2025. Square Enix shipped the third and final volume on November 12, 2025.

Asakura launched the Shikizaki Shimai wa Abakaretai ( I Want to Be Exposed by the Shikizaki Sisters ) manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump magazine in December 2021 and ended it in April 2023. Shueisha published the manga's fifth and final volume in June 2023.

Asakura's launched the Val x Love ( Ikusa x Koi ) manga in Monthly Shonen Gangan in December 2015 and ended it in March 2023. Square Enix published the manga's 16th and final volume in May 2023, and Yen Press published that final volume in English in March 2024. The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in October 2019. Sentai Filmworks streamed the anime on HIDIVE as it aired in Japan, and released the anime on Blu-ray Disc in November 2020.
author: ANN

title: 3 Super Saiyan Transformations in Dragon Ball Fans Will Never See Again
content:
The Saiyan Saga in Dragon Ball Z was a huge turning point, and the story hasn’t been the same ever since. It revealed Goku’s origins as a member of the proud warrior race, which explains a lot about his natural talent as a martial artist. Following that, the series also introduced the Super Saiyan form, and no moment in Shonen history has ever been as iconic as Goku’s first transformation . Over the decades, the franchise introduced several Shonen tropes that continue to inspire countless mangakas and popular shows even today. The most popular trope among them was transformations, which became a standard for action Shonen. Of course, even within the Dragon Ball universe, no transformation is as powerful and exceptional as a Super Saiyan.

The series has introduced several Super Saiyan transformations over the years, but not many hit the mark as they should have. This includes both the canon and the anime original transformations. These three Super Saiyan transformations have become irrelevant over the years, and fans might never see them again. It’s not just because these forms are weak or have many drawbacks, but the main reason is how the power level has changed completely in Dragon Ball Super , making these forms pretty much useless.

3) Pseudo Super Saiyan

Many fans probably don’t remember or even know about this underrated form since it’s an anime original. This form was featured only in the 1991 movie, Dragon Ball Z: Lord Slug . Pseudo Super Saiyan is a semi-advanced technique that happens when a Saiyan is on the brink of death, where they briefly reach the state of a Super Saiyan. During the movie, Goku was initially overpowered by Lord Slug, but he easily got the upper hand after transforming, as he became uncontrollable, reminding King Kai of the Super Saiyan form from the legend.

However, unlike what the name suggests, it’s not technically a Super Saiyan form. The anime featured Goku’s first transformation right around the time of this movie, which is why it didn’t feature the real form so the series’ spotlight wouldn’t be hindered. The 1991 movie is the only time Pseudo Super Saiyan was shown, and there’s no reason for the anime to focus on it again .

2) Super Saiyan Third Grade

This was more like a sub-form before the concept of Super Saiyan 2 was introduced. However, the sub-grades were flawed and came with more drawbacks as compared to the powers they granted. This form granted brute strength in exchange for speed, which isn’t really considered a smart move when most villains in the series are just as fas they are powerful. This is especially true for Cell since this transformation was introduced during the Cell Saga.

However, another issue is that the overly buff form looks especially jarring, making it all the more unforgettable. Future Trunks used it during his fight with the villain, and he was able to surpass the power of Super Saiyan. He unlocked this ability while training in the Hyper Time Chamber. Trunks was able to fight Cell on equal footing for a brief time before the villain learned about the speed disadvantage and exploited it to gain the upper hand.

1) Super Saiyan 3

Super Saiyan 3 remains one of the most polarizing transformations in the entire franchise. It was introduced in the Buu Saga and didn’t get any chance for development since the main story was over not long after that. Goku’s Super Saiyan 3 merely served as a distraction so the Z Fighters could carry out their plan against the overpowered villain. Unfortunately, this form had way too many drawbacks to be considered useful. While it does grant immeasurable power to the Saiyan, it comes at a steep price of draining all of their stamina.

Not to mention that Goku was unable to continue the fight for a long time after using this form since he was forced back into return to the other world, as he was already dead. Additionally, the anime did revive this form in Dragon Ball Daima only to give Vegeta a brief moment of time to shine before Goku took over the spotlight again with Super Saiyan 4.

title: Puchimas! -Petit Idolm@ster- Manga to End on December 25
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Tuesday that Akane's Puchimas! -Petit Idolm@ster- manga will end in the magazine on December 25. Kadokawa will ship the 16th and last volume at the end of February 2027.

The series depicts the overly hyper daily life of The IDOLM@STER 's 765Pro idols — and mysterious creatures named "Puchidoru" who somewhat resemble the idols.

Akane launched the four-panel manga series in the magazine in 2008. Kadokawa shipped the 15th compiled book volume in December 2024.

The manga's fifth , sixth , 10th , and 11th compiled volumes all bundled anime DVDs in 2013, 2014, March 2018, and April 2018 respectively.

Dengeki Maoh also bundled the Puchimas! Wakku Waku—! —! DVD in October 2012.

The manga inspired the PUCHIM@S net anime in 2013 and a second season in 2014. Funimation streamed both seasons and released them on DVD in 2015.

title: New Zombie Anime Sets Crunchyroll Release Date in Time for Halloween – Watch Trailer
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and the new lineup is more exciting than ever with the return of Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and some of the most anticipated series with sequels. The final quarter of this year also has a list of exciting new anime series lineup for this season. Crunchyroll is the largest anime streaming platform for fans across the world. Each season, the platform adds dozens of anime shows to its library and makes them more accessible for fans. The new shows air new episodes weekly, and the platform adds them shortly after the Japanese broadcast. In most cases, the anime also get English dubs, at least two weeks after their premiere, which is always announced by the platform.

It just so happens that the final quarter of the year commences in October, which is also the month for Halloween. Since it’s right around the corner, Crunchyroll confirmed just the right anime for fans who love adventure and supernatural themes. Not to mention that there’s nothing better than a zombie show to watch during Halloween. Shortly before its premiere, Crunchyroll just confirmed I’m Looking for Zombie will begin streaming on October 3rd, 2026.

I’m Looking for Zombie Is Coming to Crunchyroll in October

While the anime was announced a while ago, Crunchyroll only just confirmed streaming it. The platform shared a new trailer on September 15th, 2026, around the same time as the Fall 2026 anime schedule was released . The schedule includes almost all of the new titles coming to the platform next month, including I’m Looking for Zombie . However, while the release date has been revealed, the timing will be shared shortly before the premiere.

Usually it takes at least a couple of hours after the Japanese broadcast to begin streaming the episode. Additionally, there’s another list of announcements for the English dubs , which doesn’t include this upcoming zombie anime. We can expect a delay on dubs, but that will only be revealed after the premiere. Apart from Crunchyroll, no other platform has confirmed this show’s release date so far.

What Is I’m Looking for Zombie About?

The anime is based on a short manga written and illustrated by Katsuwo, best known for creating the critically acclaimed series Hitoribocchi no ○○ Seikatsu. I’m Looking for Zombie was only serialized for a few months between 2022 and 2023, and it didn’t take long for Studio Comet to pick up the series. The anime was officially announced in September last year, and the release date is closer than ever.

The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where 90% of the population has died from a deadly disease, only to rise up as zombies again. 13 years have passed since that day, and now the surviving humans are forced to live away from cities. Aki has no memories of what the world was like before the fall, but she somehow manages to escape her village with her friends to look for her missing father.

title: Sekina Aoi's Asobi no Kankei Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content:
The 18th issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Sekina Aoi 's Asobi no Kankei novels will get a manga adaptation by Koruri in the next issue on September 25. Kurehito Misaki is credited as the character designer.

The story follows dropout Kotarou Tokiwa, who is a substitute manager for the board game cafe Kurumaza. He falls in love with his coworker Mifuru Takanashi, a fashionable girl with no love for board games. Unfortunately for Kotarou, Mifuru has a boyfriend. He invents an imaginary girlfriend to hide his crush, who turns out to be a regular customer of the store.

Kadokawa 's Fujimi Fantasia Bunko imprint publishes the novels with illustrations by Misaki, and shipped the fourth novel on August 20.

Aoi and Ryō Tsuzura debuted the My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on August 28. Yen Press licensed the manga. The series is inspiring an anime.

Aoi and Sabotenn launched the Gamers! novel series in 2014. Tsubasa Takahashi launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in October 2016. The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in July 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. Funimation streamed an English dub and released the series on home video.

Aoi's previous Seitokai no Ichizon light novel series inspired The Student Council's Discretion television anime series in 2009, and the Student Council's Discretion Lv. 2 television anime series in 2012. Sentai Filmworks released the first anime on home video in March 2015, and released the second anime in May 2015.
author: ANN

title: Duel Masters Play's Smartphone Game Gets Duel Masters Pure Play's Manga
content:
A new manga titled Duel Masters Pure Play's , based on the Duel Masters Play's smartphone game, launched in Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga service on Monday. Reki Yayoi is drawing the manga. Hirokuni Nojima - the art director, character designer, and story writer for Duel Masters Play's - is credited for the manga's original story and supervision.

The manga is set in Duema City, a city where lovers of Duel Masters gather together. The manga centers on Kanon and Wedding, who are beings known as "Zeniths," who only have a vague understanding of human emotions and society. Through interacting with the various personalities and experiences of the city, they slowly come to an understanding of emotions.

The Duel Masters Play's smartphone game launched in December 2019.

Based on the long-running Duel Masters trading card game, Yō Kanebayashi and Shigenobu Matsumoto 's Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō ( Duel Masters LOST: Crystal of Remembrance) manga launched in February 2024 and ended in March 2024. Kanebayashi and Matsumoto then launched the Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ ( Duel Masters LOST: Reaper of the Moon) manga in August 2024, and ended it in February 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ , the third part of the manga, debuted in September 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy), the fourth part , debuted on March 26, and ended on July 2. The final chapter revealed the manga will have a fifth part titled "Shitsuraku no Duel," which will debut on September 17.

The net anime adaptation of Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō debuted in October 2024 and had four episodes. The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ debuted in December 2024 and ended with its fourth and final episode in February 2025.The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ debuted on February 6 with a four-episode streaming run. The anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ , will debut on October 9, and will stream four episodes.

title: Yuna Anisaki Launches Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto Manga on September 18
content:
Shogakukan 's Yawaraka Spirits manga website revealed last Friday that Yuna Anisaki will launch a new manga adapting Kazuki Karasawa 's Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto (The Black and White Duties of the Inner Palace's Lady of Go) novel. The manga will launch on September 18.

The fantasy story is set in the country of Ginran. It centers on Kairin, a girl whose strange black and white hair earns her scorn from all, This includes her parents, who mostly confine her to a room where she passes the time playing go by herself. One day, she runs away from home, and has a chance encounter with Seiken, who turns out to be Ginran's crown prince. When they play go together, Seiken looks up to Kairin as a master, and they swear never to be apart. But a palace conspiracy threatens Seiken's life, and they are forced to separate. Ten years later, Kairin sells herself to the services of the imperial rear palace, and there finds Seiken, now the emperor. Since their separation, Seiken has clung to the memory of Kairin. For the sake of her safety, Kairin hides her true identity, but another chance encounter allows Seiken a chance to see Kairin solve a problematic go puzzle.

Karasawa serialized the story in Kadokawa 's Kakuyomu website from April 23 to June 14 earlier this year. Kadokawa released the print volume of the story on June 15, with illustrations by Kasumi Nagi .

JManga previously released Momoshiro and Anisaki's My Sadistic Boyfriend ( S Kareshi Jyou-Jyou ) manga digitally in English, and Azuki ( now Omoi ) also began releasing it in 2023, distributed by Media Do International.

Cross Infinite World has published Karasawa's Too Strong to Belong! Banished to Another World! ( Saikyō Joshi, Isekai e Iku! ) and The Weakest Manga Villainess Wants Her Freedom! ( Maō-gun Shitennō no Saijaku Reijō wa Jiyū ni Ikitai! ) light novels in English.

title: BookWalker Expands Catalog with Mahjong Pros Publishing Titles
content:
Kadokawa 's BookWalker Global store announced on Tuesday that it is partnering with Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint to expand its catalog with the publisher's titles.

The retailer added the following titles on the same day:

• Senba Kurono's 136 Ready-to-Use Mahjong Strategies and Tactics

• Hideki Ohwada's Reform with No Wasted Draws - The Legend of Koizumi (Volumes 1-2)

• Mio Junta and Suda Yoshiki's Crybaby Mermaid - Illustrated Memoir of Yuumi Uotani

• Ayato Sasakura's Vermilion Stella - Illustrated Memoir of Arisa Date (Volume 1)

BookWalker launched a new rebuilt website , apps, and reader in March, which includes the previously announced new Lightweight Content Protection (LCP) DRM system, which allows users to access purchases through LCP-compatible reading apps outside of BookWalker .

All English-language manga and light novels moved to the new BookWalker website and app, while Japanese content will remain on the existing website and app.

BookWalker Global changed in ownership from BookWalker Co., Ltd. to M12 Media LLC (formerly J-Novel Club LLC) in March 2025. BookWalker Co., Ltd. and J-Novel Club /M12 Media LLC are both Kadokawa Group companies.

The Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint focuses on licensing, localizing, and distributing mahjong-themed manga and textbooks. The company announced its Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint in June 2025.

The retailer added the following titles on the same day:
Senba Kurono's 136 Ready-to-Use Mahjong Strategies and Tactics
Hideki Ohwada's Reform with No Wasted Draws - The Legend of Koizumi (Volumes 1-2)
Mio Junta and Suda Yoshiki's Crybaby Mermaid - Illustrated Memoir of Yuumi Uotani
Ayato Sasakura's Vermilion Stella - Illustrated Memoir of Arisa Date (Volume 1)

BookWalker launched a new rebuilt website , apps, and reader in March, which includes the previously announced new Lightweight Content Protection (LCP) DRM system, which allows users to access purchases through LCP-compatible reading apps outside of BookWalker .
All English-language manga and light novels moved to the new BookWalker website and app, while Japanese content will remain on the existing website and app.

BookWalker Global changed in ownership from BookWalker Co., Ltd. to M12 Media LLC (formerly J-Novel Club LLC) in March 2025. BookWalker Co., Ltd. and J-Novel Club /M12 Media LLC are both Kadokawa Group companies.
The Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint focuses on licensing, localizing, and distributing mahjong-themed manga and textbooks. The company announced its Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint in June 2025.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Kagurabachi, More Manga Rank on NYT September Bestseller List
content:
The manga on this month's list include:

• #7 — Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen volume 1

• #9 — Takeru Hokazono's Kagurabachi volume 8

• #15 — Mokumokuren's The Summer Hikaru Died volume 1

The first volume of Jujutsu Kaisen ranked at #7 in August. The 30th volume of Jujutsu Kaisen ranked at #9 and the first volume of The Summer Hikaru Died ranked at #15 in the same month.

The New York Times posted its first updated Graphic Books and Manga bestseller list in October 2019, and it is one category of the newspaper's current bestseller lists.

title: Goodbye, Lara Anime Gets Manga
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kinema Citrus ' Goodbye, Lara ( Sayonara Lara ) original anime announced on Tuesday that the series will get a manga adaptation by Citrus creator Saburouta on Kadokawa 's KadoComi manga platform in October.

Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs and describes the story:

Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch's potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

The anime debuted on Sunday, July 5 at 24:30 (effectively July 6 at 12:30 a.m.) on Tokyo MX , before airing later that night on BS Asahi and YTV . The anime also airs on AT-X . Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub .

Takushi Koide is directing the series at Kinema Citrus , and Anna Kawahara is overseeing the series scripts. Shiori Tani is the character designer, and Yuma Yamaguchi is composing the music at Kadokawa .

Ikimono-gakari performs the anime's opening theme song " Sayonara Lara ."

Goodbye, Lara tells a tale similar to Hans Christian Andersen 's The Little Mermaid . The story follows a mermaid who makes a forbidden wish to be loved by a human. Following her death, she is reborn 200 years later into modern-day Japan in Lake Biwa, where she learns to adjust in a human world. The setting of Lake Biwa is in Shiga prefecture of Japan, which is also where director Takushi Koide 's hometown is located.
